plan.title: Reverse Auction Auto Title for Three Products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Switch the event type from the initial RFP state to an auction.
Apply the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is available; the case does not name the reverse-auction template.
Confirm that an auction template was applied and the template picker is no longer empty.
Add the second named product from a different product family.
Confirm that all three product rows are present before inspecting the generated title.
